#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long powerMod(long long b, long long e, long long m) {
    long long x = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1)
            x = (b * x) % m;
        b = (b * b) % m;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n, m;
    int L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    const long long mod = 998244353;
    long long inv2 = powerMod(2, mod - 2, mod);
    long long diff = R - L + 1;
    long long p1 = diff / 2;
    long long p2 = diff - p1;
    long long nm = n * m;

    long long ans;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = powerMod(diff, nm, mod);
    } else {
        long long diffPow = powerMod(diff, nm, mod);
        long long absPow = powerMod(abs(p1 - p2), nm, mod);
        ans = ((diffPow + absPow) % mod * inv2) % mod;
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
